name: Next.js
covers: Linter-equivalent to @next/eslint-plugin-next 16.3.8, for pages, images, fonts and scripts. Also Rerail's own App Router practice rules.

rules.title: No before interactive script outside document
Next.js practice: A Server Action that writes to the database checks the session inside the action
Next.js practice: Check a Server Function's arguments at run time before they become a Prisma filter
Next.js practice: Never give a secret a NEXT_PUBLIC_ name or put it in next.config's env
Next.js practice: Put middleware.ts or proxy.ts beside the app's app/ or pages/ directory, and use proxy.ts only on Next.js 16
Next.js practice: A function cached with unstable_cache takes per-request values as arguments or keyParts, never from the function around it
Next.js practice: Call redirect() and notFound() outside a try whose catch swallows errors, or rethrow them with unstable_rethrow
Next.js practice: revalidatePath names a route the app has
Next.js practice: revalidateTag and updateTag name a tag some cached read is given
Next.js practice: Read cookies(), headers() and searchParams outside 'use cache' and unstable_cache scopes and pass the values in
